about_the_game:
City, City, the best team in the land and all the world!

Are you ready to play like a Champion?

The Manchester City Pack is a must for any football fan.

Bring that winning mentality to Funko Fusion as Pep Guardiola, Erling Haaland, Phil Foden and Ederson and represent Manchester City in this all action DLC pack!

Pep Guardiola

We’ve got Guardiola
We’ve got
Guardiola

Twelve league titles, three Champions League wins – Pep Guardiola can’t stop winning. Football’s most iconic manager is now joining the fun as a playable character in Funko Fusion!

 

Erling Haland

Erling
Erling Erling
Erling Erling
Erling Erling Haaland

 

Europe’s deadliest striker is now available in Funko Fusion! Blast your opponents with the football cannon whilst playing as Erling Haaland – goalscoring royalty!

 

Phil Foden

He’s one of our own
He’s one our own
Phil Foden


He's one of our own

Everyone loves a homegrown talent and Manchester City’s heartbeat Phil Foden is no exception! Jump into Funko Fusion as the England international right now!

  

Ederson

Brazilian international Ederson has had a glittering career with Manchester City and you can play as him in Funko Fusion! Target enemies with the football cannon and if a bad guy is too close, clobber them with your giant goalkeeper glove!

 

The Funko Fusion Manchester City Pack is a must for every Man City fan!
